data.name: Thuggin It Further
data.detailed_description:
Team up with 2-4 players in a ship. You'll have the ship split between 4 different roles, with some removed with fewer players:

  • Driver - The leader at the wheel, steer the ship and manage your fuel while dodging asteroids

  • Energy - Manage power cells, giving more power to navigation to drive faster, more power to guns to shoot faster and improve different weapons, increase the defense of the ship, or light up the darkness to navigate clearer. While idle, you can view the radar to give directions to the driver.

  • Weapons - Shoot asteroids and enemies trying to board your ship. Once in danger, you can resort to torpedoes for massive splash damage at a limited ammo cost with slow manual reloads.

  • Engineer - Once asteroids break through, they'll slam on your ship and create holes that you'll need a wrench to fix. While your teammates are navigating, you're able to leave the ship and hop onto asteroids to mine for some money to buy goods at civilizations. Be careful not to get caught between two asteroids...

Using these jobs, you'll navigate through asteroid fields looking for planets, that contain caves with loot and dangerous enemies. At the end of planets, you'll find a massive boss enemy that can drop valuable loot for when you continue on to future planets.

data.short_description: High intensity co-op roguelite space adventure party game for 2–4 players (or bots). Take on crew jobs, keep a failing ship alive, and survive procedural missions with endless exploration, light RPG progression, and real-time crisis gameplay.
